1. A closed mode allowlist. Implement now: `plan`, `status`, `authorize`, `verify-system-archetype-empty`, `complete`. Every other design mode name (delete-<relation>, rewrite-<relation>, restore-services, abort-relation-<relation>) must be recognised and refused with failure code `mode_not_implemented_until_p2b2`; any other string is refused as unknown. 4. `authorize`: requires an authenticated plan receipt (path argument + expected SHA-256 argument, both verified; the plan must be no older than a bounded age and its identities must still match live state); calls v3_meta.begin_derived_generation_purge exactly as 016 expects (one transaction: requests + FAILED transitions); verifies the published pointer and counts unchanged after.
5. `verify-system-archetype-empty`: proves in the action that the three cluster relations and wide system_archetype hold zero target rows (and the summary view none); any row stops with FAILED_STOP semantics as 016 defines; deletes nothing.
6. `complete`: calls v3_meta.complete_derived_generation_purge with the completion receipt; before it, proves design 4.3 step 10's conditions it can read (zero target rows everywhere, unchanged pointers, exact published counts vs plan, valid FKs, no open fence, every relation's REWRITE_VERIFIED present); refuses otherwise.
